payload.title: Refine Residio HMM state naming quality
payload.description: Follow up on the new topic-driven Residio HMM output. The full-corpus run removed the generic unknown label and produced unique START/END states, but one learned state still received the broad name 'Unassigned State'. Improve the state_naming prompt and/or exemplar selection so generic fallback names are less likely in client-facing reports.
